claim: Review why a reentrancy lock prevents an external callee from receiving control.
reasons: No verified supporting excerpt for claim: Review why a reentrancy lock prevents an external callee from receiving control.

claim_support.claim_text: Review why a reentrancy lock prevents an external callee from receiving control.
claim_support.evidence_quote: A lock blocks the unwanted callback into the protected path; it does not prevent control passing to the external callee.

claim: Review why SanadSquad audited 500 protocols for reentrancy.
reasons: No verified supporting excerpt for claim: Review why SanadSquad audited 500 protocols for reentrancy.

claim_support.claim_text: Review why SanadSquad audited 500 protocols for reentrancy.
claim_support.evidence_quote: An external contract can take over control flow and call back before the first function invocation finishes. Remediation: perform internal state changes before the external call, using checks-effects-interactions, or use a reentrancy lock.
